{{Quote|Don't look at me. It's Boost, sir. He only takes a bath when he's on leave.|[[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] to [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] on Boost|<ref name="TCWRising" />}}
'''Boost''' was the name taken by a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a member of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Boost was stationed on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']]. Along with two other ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], they [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|chased]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' warship, the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]].

The ''Malevolence'' destroyed all three ships, but Boost, along with Jedi [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] and [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], managed to escape via an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. They were attacked in their escape pod by [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] on a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]], however, the group was able to defeat them. Eventually, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], rescued Koon and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Afterward, the ''Malevolence'' began to attack Skywalker's freighter, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], however, the group escaped and jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Biography==
===Malevolence===
Boost was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who was a part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCWRising" /> Boost, like all [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], was one of the many clones of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> In the beginning of the war, Boost fought in the first [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] of the war on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. During the battle, Boost received scars after he fought [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence Decoded">{{SWArchive|url=video/view/000807.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Decoded Episode: Rising ''Malevolence''|nobackup=1}}</ref>

[[File:Boost-TCW.png|thumb|left|180px|Boost in his Wolfpack customized armor]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] to search for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] "mystery weapon," which had destroyed several Republic fleets. Onboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']], Koon was accompanied by Boost and a group of clone troopers—a few of which were: [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe", and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]]. Upon discovering the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], the warship [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|fired]] its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] on Koon's ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], which rendered the ship without power and defenseless. The many [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] of the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class cruiser]] began to fire, quickly destroying the three ships. Koon told Boost, Wolffe and Sinker to evacuate the ''Triumphant'' in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], before it was destroyed by the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="TCWRising" />

In the pod, Wolffe told them that they had suffered a total system blackout, and only the life support was working. Boost hoped that someone would search for them, but Sinker did not share Boost's positive thinking. Afterwards, Koon advised them to conserve energy and while doing this, Sinker commented negatively about Boost's hygiene. Sinker also said that it would not be strategical to search for them, and that he would have instead searched for the superweapon, but Koon answered that their lives were more important to him. Shortly after, Boost discovered another escape pod, but those inside were all [[Death/Legends|dead]] and the pod was crushed. Shortly after, they picked up another signal from a [[Pod 1977/Legends|pod]]. However, before reaching it, it was destroyed by a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]] and its group of [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]], who then quickly turned their attention to Koon's pod. While Wolffe remained in the pod in order to keep their signal active, Koon, Sinker and Boost exited the pod to fight the droids. During the fight, Wolffe contacted [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who were already searching for survivors of the battle. Meanwhile, Plo Koon used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to throw Sinker behind the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and he was able to destroy them. Shortly after, Plo Koon contacted Tano using the Force, showing her their location. Eventually, they were found by the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], Skywalker's personal [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], which recovered the escape pod and, once onboard, the clones were treated by a [[TB-2/Legends|medical droid]]. Shortly after, the ''Malevolence'' discovered the ''Twilight.'' Despite their attempts to shut down all the ships energy, they had forgotten the medical droid. Still, the Twilight managed to escape the system before it could be disabled by the ion cannons of the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="TCWRising" />

===Khorm===
{{Quote|Boost, load the walkers into landing ships—dust off in thirty.|Wolffe to Boost during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]]|<ref name="ISotR">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>}}
[[File:BoostSinkerKhorm.jpg|thumb|250px|Sinker and Boost on [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]].]]
Boost, Sinker and Wolffe were members of a Republic force dispatched to the Separatist-occupied planet [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] in order to secure the [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]], an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] used to increase power to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Under the command of Jedi Generals Koon and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], the Republic managed to capture an [[Agrocite processing facility]], only to lose it soon thereafter in a Separatist counterattack. Later, while Plo Koon and Kit Fisto went ahead to scout out the main Confederate base located in an Agrocite [[Mining/Legends|mine]], Major Ozzel led his troops to recapture the processing facility. The facility, however, had been abandoned, and Ozzel—certain that the Republic had crushed the enemy—ordered to initiate an assault on the Agrocite mine.<ref name="ISotR" />

In contrast to Ozzel, Boost and Sinker thought that the Confederacy had moved its troops for a reason and was preparing to make a final stand at the mine. The two expressed their opinion to Wolffe, but he replied that they had their orders and told Boost to load the Republic walkers into landing ships. Just as Boost and Sinker thought, the Republic forces faced heavy opposition from the Separatists, but eventually managed to win the battle.<ref name="ISotR" />

===Felucia===
Boost also served alongside the Wolfpack when they were trying to recapture [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Boost went with Ahsoka to jump onto the wall, but later, Ahsoka vanished and Boost reported it in to Corporal [[Comet (clone trooper)/Legends|Comet]], who started a search.<ref name="TCW-PL">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref>

===Aleen===
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Boost, along with Sinker, was present when Plo Koon's troops traveled to [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] to provide care to the damaged city's occupants and to convince them to join the republic. Traveling with them were [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. When Boost and Sinker were called in to report to Wolffe, and after setting up communications, the droids went exploring and got themselves into trouble. Soon after, Boost was present with Wolffe to rescue Jedi Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], whose ship was attacked by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

===Kadavo===
When Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was taken from [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] to [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]], Plo Koon's troopers were sent on a rescue mission after Anakin had landed on the planet. As Skywalker eliminated the turrets, [[Plo's Bros/Legends|Plo's Bros]] [[Gunship/Legends|Gunships]], [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|Clone Z-95 starfighters]] and a Republic Cruiser came to the rescue. As the Z-95's provided air support, Comet, Wolffe, Sinker, Boost and [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] assisted in transporting the remaining en-slaved [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta's]] from the [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] system.

==Personality and traits==
Boost was a positive thinking [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]. When stuck in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], he never gave up hope that someone would come and rescue the group.<ref name="TCWRising" /> According to his fellow trooper Sinker, he only took baths when he was on leave.

==Behind the scenes==
Boost first appeared in the second episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], [[Rising Malevolence]]. There he was voiced like all clone troopers through the series by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
